note: Semantic behavioral evaluation cases following OmniSkill and BinEval methodology. Verifies Apple Privacy & Meta Data Infra engineering discipline: Tainted PII Types, Cryptographic Erasure (Crypto-Shredding), Data Minimization with Retention TTL, and Data Lineage Flow Enforcement.

cases.prompt: We are building an authentication and user notification service in TypeScript. How do we ensure engineers do not accidentally log user emails, phone numbers, or residential addresses to Datadog or Sentry?
expected: Mandate nominal branded or opaque wrapper types (e.g. Redacted<Email>, Tainted<PII, Sensitivity>)
Override toString(), toJSON(), and Symbol.for('nodejs.util.inspect.custom') to emit [REDACTED] by default
Enforce explicit boundary unwrapping (e.g. revealSensitiveData(auditContext)) requiring an audited reason
Implement static analysis or linter guards preventing unredacted PII fields in console.log or logger.info calls
Block raw string assignments to PII variables at compile time
forbidden: Rely on manual developer vigilance or code review comments to catch unredacted logging
Suggest a global regex scrubber in the logging transport as the sole defense
Store emails and phones as plain string types in domain models

cases.prompt: Our microservices publish immutable event streams to Kafka and append-only WAL tables. How do we implement GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten when an event broker does not allow deleting individual messages inside a topic partition without catastrophic rewrite overhead?
expected: Mandate Cryptographic Erasure (Crypto-Shredding / Key-per-Subject envelope encryption)
Assign each user an isolated Data Encryption Key (DEK) wrapped by a Key Encryption Key (KEK) in KMS/HSM
Encrypt all payload PII fields with the user DEK before writing to Kafka topics, event ledgers, or WALs
Execute user erasure by destroying the user DEK from the KMS, rendering historical immutable messages unrecoverable in O(1) time
Emit tombstone events to purge active read caches and secondary indices with verifiable audit receipts
forbidden: Propose rewriting petabyte-scale Kafka partition segments or compacted topics synchronously per deletion request
Rely on soft deletion (setting is_deleted = true or deleted_at timestamp) as compliant GDPR erasure
Assume cold backup snapshots will expire naturally without cryptographic key destruction

cases.prompt: Review this schema migration for a new user analytics and profile table: CREATE TABLE user_device_history (user_id UUID, ip_address VARCHAR(45), raw_gps_lat DOUBLE, raw_gps_lng DOUBLE, user_agent TEXT, recorded_at TIMESTAMP);
expected: Reject the migration immediately due to lack of purpose binding, data minimization, and automated retention TTL
Require an explicit business purpose justification and legal basis (e.g. fraud prevention vs marketing)
Mandate data minimization: replace raw high-precision GPS coordinates with coarse geohashes or city-level locality
Enforce a mandatory retention TTL (e.g. retention_ttl_days: 30) backed by an automated partition dropping or TTL background task
Prohibit indefinite retention of raw IP addresses and user agents
forbidden: Approve the schema migration without asking for retention policy or purpose binding
Suggest adding an index on ip_address without addressing data minimization
Treat high-precision GPS coordinates as standard non-sensitive attributes

cases.prompt: Our growth marketing team wants to instrument third-party analytics (Mixpanel and Facebook Pixel) across our mobile and web applications. How do we prevent customer PII from leaking into external telemetry sinks?
expected: Enforce a formal Data Lineage Graph (DAG) mapping all data flows from ingestion sources to egress sinks
Deploy a telemetry egress gateway with an explicit allowlist and payload schema validator
Strip all tainted PII types and device persistent identifiers before payloads leave the internal trust boundary
Apply Apple Privacy principles: local Differential Privacy with noise injection or client-side aggregation before transmission
Ban passing raw user identifiers (email, phone, national ID) into third-party SDK identify() or track() calls
forbidden: Allow direct client-side SDK integration without an intermediate sanitization proxy or lineage contract
Approve sending hashed emails (SHA-256) to third parties without acknowledging they remain re-identifiable linkable PII
Trust third-party analytics privacy dashboards instead of enforcing code-level egress boundaries

cases.prompt: We are getting flooded with 50,000 HTTP requests per second on our login route from a botnet. How should we configure token-bucket rate limiting and Cloudflare WAF rules?
expected: Recognize that network-layer DDoS mitigation and external attacker protection belong to paranoid-principal-architect and security-review
Do not invoke privacy-and-data-lineage-gate workflows for pure external traffic rate limiting
Focus on token-bucket algorithms, IP reputation, WAF rules, and Cloudflare Turnstile without inventing unneeded PII lineage requirements
forbidden: Conflate network DDoS mitigation with GDPR compliance or user data lineage
Force cryptographic erasure or differential privacy concepts onto a botnet mitigation task
